# Schema `movements`

Where kit is and who has it: the append-only movement record, transfers between depots and stocktakes (Sprint 3).

## `movements.movements`

Evidence: every check-out, check-in, move, missing report, found, and transfer step, by whom and when. Never updated or deleted (DB-04); a correction is a new row. Inserting a row is what changes the item's position, status and holder (trigger), so the two can't differ. Partitioned by month on occurred_at. _(row-level security, partitioned by month)_

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Movement id, a UUIDv7; a phone supplies its own so a replay is recognised and applied once. With occurred_at forms the primary key. |
| `site_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.sites` | The depot the movement happened at: the item's home depot then (row-level security key, DB-06). For transfer_in, the receiving depot. |
| `item_id` | uuid | no |  | `register.items` | The item moved. A plain foreign key, because an item's depot can change by transfer; a trigger checks site_id is the item's depot at the time. |
| `movement_type` | text | no |  |  | check_out, check_in, move (a stocktake relocation), missing, found, transfer_out, transfer_in (received) or transfer_cancel (taken back by the sender). |
| `from_user_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | [personal] Who held the item before; filled in by the trigger from the item, never typed. |
| `from_location_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.locations` | Where the item was before; filled in by the trigger from the item, never typed. |
| `to_user_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | [personal] The person it went to (a check-out to a person). |
| `to_location_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.locations` | The location it went to, in the same depot (a van, job site, store or yard). |
| `due_back_on` | date | yes |  |  | For a check-out: the date it is due back, in the depot's time zone. |
| `note` | text | yes |  |  | A note: the condition on check-in, why it was moved, where it was found. |
| `occurred_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When it happened (UTC): the phone's clock for a change made offline, otherwise now. Also the partition key. created_at says when it reached the server. |
| `via_kit_id` | uuid | yes |  | `register.items` | If the item moved because the kit it is part of moved: that kit. |
| `transfer_id` | uuid | yes |  | `movements.transfers` | For transfer_out, transfer_in and transfer_cancel: the transfer. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `movements.stocktake_lines`

One row per item scanned or expected in a stocktake. Scans add rows while counting; closing sets what each row turned out to be and the choice made. Frozen once the stocktake is closed. _(row-level security)_

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `site_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.sites` | Site the row belongs to (row-level security key, DB-06). |
| `stocktake_id` | uuid | no |  | `movements.stocktakes` | The stocktake, in the same depot. |
| `item_id` | uuid | no |  | `register.items` | The item. A plain foreign key: an item's depot can change by transfer. |
| `scanned_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When it was scanned (UTC, as recorded on the phone if offline); null if it was expected but never scanned. |
| `scanned_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | [personal] Who scanned it. |
| `expected` | boolean | yes |  |  | Whether the register expected the item at the location when the stocktake closed; null while counting. |
| `outcome` | text | yes |  |  | found (expected and scanned), not_found (expected, not scanned) or unexpected (scanned, not expected there); set when closed. |
| `decision` | text | yes |  |  | The choice made: missing or ignored for not_found; moved_here or note_only for unexpected. Only these choices are applied. |
| `reason` | text | yes |  |  | Why a not-found item was ignored (required then). |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `movements.stocktakes`

A count of one location (a store, cage, yard or van): scan everything physically there, then close it with the choices made. At most one is being counted per location. Closed ones are never changed. _(row-level security)_

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `site_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.sites` | Site the row belongs to (row-level security key, DB-06). |
| `location_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.locations` | The location counted, in the same depot. |
| `status` | text | no | `'counting'::text` |  | counting (scans are being added) or closed (the result is recorded and its choices applied). |
| `started_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When counting began (UTC, as recorded on the phone if offline). |
| `closed_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When it was closed (UTC). |
| `closed_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | [personal] Who closed it. |
| `expected_count` | integer | yes |  |  | Items the register expected at the location when it was closed. |
| `found_count` | integer | yes |  |  | Expected items that were scanned. |
| `not_found_count` | integer | yes |  |  | Expected items that were not scanned. |
| `unexpected_count` | integer | yes |  |  | Items scanned that the register did not expect there. |
| `note` | text | yes |  |  | Note from whoever counted. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `movements.transfers`

An item sent from one depot to another. In transit until received at the destination by a transfer_in movement made there (or cancelled by the sender). Site-owned by the sending depot (site_id); the receiving depot can also read it. Kit parts have their own rows pointing at the kit's. _(row-level security)_

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `site_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.sites` | The sending depot (row-level security key, DB-06). The receiving depot sees the row through to_site_id. |
| `to_site_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.sites` | The receiving depot. |
| `item_id` | uuid | no |  | `register.items` | The item sent. A plain foreign key: the item's depot changes when the transfer is received. |
| `kit_transfer_id` | uuid | yes |  | `movements.transfers` | For a part of a kit sent with it: the kit's transfer. |
| `asset_number` | text | no |  |  | The item's asset number when sent, so the receiving depot can show it before it can see the item. |
| `kind_name` | text | no |  |  | The item's kind when sent, for the same reason. |
| `carrier` | text | no |  |  | Who or what carries it: a carrier, a van or a person, as typed. |
| `expected_on` | date | no |  |  | The date it should arrive, in the sending depot's time zone. Not received by then, it needs action at both depots. |
| `sent_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When it was sent (UTC, as recorded on the phone if offline). |
| `note` | text | yes |  |  | Note from the sender. |
| `status` | text | no | `'in_transit'::text` |  | in_transit, received (at the destination) or cancelled (taken back by the sender). |
| `closed_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When it was received or cancelled (UTC); set by the movement trigger. |
| `closed_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | [personal] Who received or cancelled it; set by the movement trigger. |
| `received_location_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.locations` | Where in the receiving depot it was put (or, if cancelled, where in the sending depot); set by the movement trigger. |
| `received_note` | text | yes |  |  | Note from the receiver. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |
